current.text: The Warriors look set to start him next to Steph Curry and Draymond Green.
He signed a contract extension with the Warriors.
Experts expect him to be a locked-in starter who plays over 30 minutes a game.
Steve Kerr is reported to love him.
Jimmy Butler is out for at least half the season, and Moses Moody is out to start the season.
With Butler out he could handle the ball more, which could give him a strong early run of assists.
Experts expect a step up in year four, with about 20% usage and gains in threes, rebounds, steals, assists and points.
He ranked 61st after the All-Star break last season and played about 32 minutes late in the season.
His shooting has been better than expected.
He could finish top 70. Experts call him good value around picks 85 to 95.
Several experts say his ESPN rank, in the high 60s to low 70s, is too high.
He is one expert's best Warriors target and is called a bit underrated.
He would gain value if Steph Curry gets hurt.
His role is seen as secure because the Warriors have very little depth.
The Warriors are reported to treat this season as a gap year. They worry about lottery odds and may rest veterans.
Experts call the Warriors a bad team. One expects Warriors players, Podziemski included, to fade as the season goes on.
It is not clear how the rotation will look once Butler and Moody return.
The Warriors schedule is good for fantasy playoffs that end March 28, but it has 15 back-to-backs.

durable.text: He is a good rebounder for a guard.
His category line has no weak category. Steals and threes are a little above the pool.
He is worth more in category leagues than in points leagues.
He sometimes has efficiency problems and lacks defense.
He tends to start seasons slowly and has struggled in the NBA playoffs.

note: At a Yahoo value of 4 USD (average cost 1.5 USD) and a Yahoo rank of 99, he is a cheap late target. He fits any build, since no category is weak and he gives a guard about 5.7 rebounds. Experts think he can top his 136th-place finish from last season (61st after the All-Star break), but pay at Yahoo's level (1 to 5 USD), not at ESPN's rank of 69. In the first weeks, check that he starts, plays 30 or more minutes and gets more assists while Butler is out. Think about selling before Butler returns, because the Warriors may fade late in the season.
